## LanguageRef

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

```ts
export interface LanguageRef {
    tag?: string;
    name: string;
}
```

**Member index** (including nested object members; inherited members are defined in the linked base types):

- [tag](#languageref-tag)
- [name](#languageref-name)

### LanguageRef tag

Canonical BCP 47 tag ("es", "pt-BR", "yue"). Absent for a language the
learner named that has no known tag.

```ts
tag?: string;
```

### LanguageRef name

English display name ("Spanish", "Cantonese").

```ts
name: string;
```

## SessionLanguage

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

A session's language pair, stamped on the record at creation.

```ts
export interface SessionLanguage {
    target: LanguageRef;
    base: LanguageRef;
}
```

**Related types:** [LanguageRef](language.md#languageref).

**Member index** (including nested object members; inherited members are defined in the linked base types):

- [target](#sessionlanguage-target)
- [base](#sessionlanguage-base)

### SessionLanguage target

The language being learned.

```ts
target: LanguageRef;
```

### SessionLanguage base

The learner's own language: explanations, glosses and feedback.

```ts
base: LanguageRef;
```
